items.title: ‘Breaking Bad’ star Dean Norris is selling 11-acre California estate for $3.2 million amid divorce
items.content: Dean Norris is looking for a buyer for his 11-acre Temecula, Calif., property, listing the hilltop home for $3.2 million—after his wife, Bridget Norris, filed for divorce.

items.title: Supermodel Bella Hadid snaps up a charming Colorado compound for $5.5 million
items.content: Bella Hadid has purchased a creekside compound in Crested Butte, Colorado, for $5.5 million.

items.title: Here’s how much of Deutsche Bank’s market cap has been wiped away after reports on 15 million leaked documents
items.content: Deutsche Bank saw as much as €3.8 billion ($4.2 billion) of its market cap wiped away after a team of media organizations wrote about a trove of 15 million leaked documents.
